chapters.title: One map of the whole Nova network
chapters.description:
15 Nova sites, 47 customers and 14 suppliers on one 3D map. Column height shows ERP + CRM users at each site, a proxy for site activity.

Customers are coloured by product family and sized by weekly shipments. Suppliers are coloured by risk.

Sample data: Nova sites from the ERP/CRM footprint (locations approximate); customers, suppliers, volumes and rates are illustrative.

chapters.title: North America: where most of the business runs
chapters.description: 81% of ERP users sit in North America. Customers span every major US metro and three Canadian hubs, served from the Massachusetts core and the Ontario forward stocking location.

chapters.title: The Massachusetts ERP core
chapters.description: Waltham HQ, three Billerica sites, Norwood and Westbrook, ME carry manufacturing, warehousing and finance. Billerica – Enterprise Rd is the main distribution centre for Critical Care and Bioprocess.

chapters.title: Europe: the UK hub and the German FSL
chapters.description: Wimborne / Ferndown is the EU hub for all four product families. The German subsidiary forward-stocks Critical Care for six countries; France and Italy are sales and service offices.

chapters.title: Asia-Pacific
chapters.description: Taipei manufactures Critical Care. Japan and Australia forward-stock it for their own markets. Korea has no local node, which is the structural gap shown in the next demos.
